scope.contract: Caller-owned reservations are visible at all times; reserveForWrite destinations are visible only during an active DXF write; handles minted by allocHandle/next remain excluded.
scope.consumer: LibreCAD filter reservation query used while preserving and reallocating source metadata handles.

baseline.result: FAIL before change: six assertions reported that planned BLOCK/ENDBLK destinations were hidden while minted BLOCK_RECORD handles remained excluded.
baseline.cause: HandleAllocator stored next()-minted identities and reserveForWrite() destinations in one set, while the public query intentionally excluded minted handles.

change.detail: Track minted and write-planned handles separately. Keep allocator collision detection and high-water computation over both sets. Expose write-planned destinations from the facade only during the admitted write attempt; keep explicit caller reservations visible independently of write lifecycle.

validation.coverage: Generated AC1009/AC1024 ASCII and binary writes; planned BLOCK/ENDBLK and minted BLOCK_RECORD/entity identities; finalization; failed write; corrected retry; explicit reservation persistence.

crossChecksAtTimeOfSlice.result: FAIL (1/1); the same boundary test also fails in the pre-existing build/ executable. This is not a passing gate for this slice and remains untriaged.

FAIL (7 assertions covering generated ACDS modeler projection/typed BOX closure, EvaluationGraph output, and HATCH source-reference ordering). The same test passes in the older build/ executable; source/build baselines differ, so causality is unestablished and these cases remain open.

followUp.result: The HATCH resolver failure was fixed and the remaining ACDS/EvaluationGraph failures were stale expected CLASSES inventories. The updated libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip test now passes 1/1; see docs/research/p8-dxf-plotstyle-resolver-identity-2026-11-17.json.
followUp.stillOpen: libdxfrw_dwg_block_control_handle_boundary remains failing in the current and pre-existing build executables; it is outside this DXF facade slice and has not been diagnosed.

fixturePolicy: All DXF test data is generated at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.
limits: The LibreCAD compatibility target is compile-time source compatibility, not a native GUI or binary-ABI result.
This closes only reservation-query semantics; broader consumer sequencing and integration remain separate gates.
No DWG/DXF family or version support claim is promoted.
